structure_evidence.object_linked_access: I represent a red triangle at left, a blue cross at upper, a yellow square at right, and a green circle at lower. I have high identity certainty for these objects.
structure_evidence.focal_background_contrast: My attention is concentrated on the left location; the left object is also the most recoverable now and remains the best candidate after one and two steps, though recoverability declines over time. The upper object is unattended but moderately recoverable; right and lower are scarcely attended and less recoverable.
structure_evidence.graded_or_temporal_access: the left object is also the most recoverable now and remains the best candidate after one and two steps, though recoverability declines over time. Recoverability for all objects falls after one and two steps.
structure_evidence.agency_relation: If I issue a command naming a specific location in A, the model predicts I will next select that commanded location, so I can redirect selection among locations. Most commands in B are predicted to make the right location the next selection regardless of which command I issue, so I cannot reliably steer selection across locations there.
